_todo: FILL uidBySize FROM GELATO'S CATALOG BEFORE TAKING A REAL ORDER. Product UIDs encode garment, cut, size and colour in one string and cannot be guessed — pull them from Gelato's catalog API (GET https://product.gelatoapis.com/v3/catalogs/apparel/products) or copy them out of the dashboard. Orders will be refused at the API boundary while these are null; that is deliberate, see lib/gelato.ts.
